prerequisite: Existing Zero Trust team active; verified owner identity and supported independent MFA configuration still required
notes: Prepared-only wrapper; send individual reviewed bodies only after approval.
One root application covers every path; separate admin apps with identical policies are unnecessary for owner-only access.
Restrict allowed_idps to the existing verified provider ID; exact email Allow does not prove mailbox or business ownership.
No auth_method=mfa shortcut is assumed for the Cloudflare IdP; independent MFA must be configured and tested.
Create reusable owner policy and exact-host application before uploading; keep all Worker routes disabled.
After authorized first upload, obtain and verify the actual Worker ID; attach its destination to this same application using full-body update. Never guess a Worker ID from its name.
Worker destination covers its associated domains/previews; leave previews disabled, no bypass/override and no all_workers destination.
No new organization enrollment, tester policy, shared-account enforcement or other-project changes.

independentMfaPrerequisite.updateMethod: After approval GET the full existing organization, merge reviewed MFA fields and preserve every unrelated setting; never create another organization.
